given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator has access to the zone management module
given_when_then.when: The operator creates a new polygon boundary for a delivery zone and publishes it
given_when_then.then: The system stores the new definition as the active version and invalidates the previous zone map

given_when_then.given: An Order Request is submitted for an address outside the defined service area
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to validate the order against the active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the order and logs the rejection reason as 'outside service zone'

success_criteria: The new Service Area Definition is stored as the active version and the previous zone map is invalidated immediately upon publication
Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition are rejected by the Order Allocation Engine and logged with the rejection reason
The system recalculates travel time matrices whenever a Service Area Definition is modified to reflect updated route constraints
All modifications to Service Area Definitions are logged with a timestamp and the identity of the Platform Operator
